dedupe_keys.name: risk data library catalog rdls implementation

description: Risk Data Library Catalog (RDLS implementation) is a data resource listed in Risk Data Library, an initiative and catalogue for disaster and climate risk data, published or maintained by Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), World Bank. It is an open data catalogue built on the JKAN software that implements the Risk Data Library Standard, to search for, compare and download disaster and climate risk datasets from several risk data sources. Its dataset feed held a single demonstration dataset when read. Coverage: worldwide, dataset by dataset. The catalogue feed https://catalog.riskdatalibrary.org/datasets.json returned one dataset on 2026-09-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue page, which was read; the resource itself was not opened, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding hazard, exposure and vulnerability datasets. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-gfdrr-risk-data-library-standard.
